title: Initial control configuration
statement: For finite Turing machines $D,M_1,M_2$ over the Boolean alphabet and any Boolean input word $x$, the initial configuration of the timed conditional machine on $x$ is the control configuration associated with the initial configuration of $D$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $D,M_1,M_2$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
